patch_description: The best prior program (score 0.76) used geometric "push" moves (displacing a vertex perpendicular to the opposite edge of the offending small triangle) rather than blind Gaussian jitter, and a two-stage anneal+reheat pipeline. The current program regressed (0.67) by replacing push moves with axis-aligned jitter. I propose: (1) reintroduce push-move proposals in both the annealer and a new strict polish, (2) add a two-tier polish (K=8 then K=4, 2500 iters each) per the recommendation so late-stage refinement focuses on truly smallest triangles, (3) add reheat cycles from the global best with fresh seeds and strict polish after each, exploiting the positive runtime/score correlation within the ~5s budget.
